decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Existing and Proposed Block and Site Plan 031 502First Floor and Second Floor GA Plan as Existing 031 500First Floor and Second Floor GA Plan as Existing 031 501First Floor and Second Floor GA Plan as Proposed 031 502Attic Plans - Existing & Proposed 031 503Front Elevation Existing 031 600Front Elevation Proposed 031 601South Rear Elevation Existing 031 602South Rear Elevation Proposed 031 603Sections & Elevations as Existing 031 604Sections & Elevations as Proposed 031 605Heritage & Design StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Prior to the installation of the air conditioning unit, an acoustic report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The report should demonstrate a noise level of 37dBA or less at nearest openable windows of neighbouring properties. In addition, there must be no evidence of specific tonal elements in all frequencies. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.  Reason: To protect the local amenity from noise and disturbance
description: Rear dormer, involving gable end roof extension, roof lights to front, changes to first floor fenestration at side and installation of solar panels and AC unit to roof at rear.
